sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211 — Kitchen Exhaust Systems
sources.description: Governs kitchen exhaust hood classification, clearance requirements, and construction standards for commercial and residential kitchens.

sources.label: NFPA 96: Standard for Ventilation Control and Fire Protection of Commercial Cooking Operations

sources.label: ASHRAE 154-2011 — Ventilation for Commercial Cooking Operations
